Two people met the same woman. One loved her, one couldn't stand her.

Kevin explains how he got along wonderfully with his girlfriend's mother, while his girlfriend saw her as terrible. Same person, same words, same behavior, two opposite experiences.

Kevin points out the mother didn't change. His takeaway: the difference is the person interacting with her.

Who do you see differently than the people around you do?

#ad #relationships #love #kevintrudeau

Most people build a network asking what they can get. Kevin says that's backwards.

Kevin Trudeau explains that we often form relationships based on what others can give us. His answer is no.

Instead, he says, approach people with the intention of what you can do for them. That is the act of giving, and he teaches that whatever you plant, you harvest.

What can you do for someone this week?

#ad #relationships #success #kevintrudeau

If it is to be, it's up to me. But Kevin says that's only half the story.

Kevin Trudeau explains that self-improvement is personal, yet you can't do it alone. When you work on yourself, you need others, just like they need you.

He says that when you take advantage of that, your energy shifts, and so does how you react and respond to people and situations.

Who around you helps you grow into a better version of yourself?
